What “comprehensive” means here

Each lesson follows the original article’s structure rather than reducing it to a few bullets. It explains the argument, defines important ideas, preserves concrete evidence and examples, turns guidance into an actionable playbook, and calls out limitations. Short announcements remain shorter; substantial technical and strategic articles receive substantially more depth.

Use Full detail for the complete lesson or Overview only for a faster pass. Search covers every nested concept, example, caution, and glossary entry.

Method and scope

This book covers all 293 article listings returned by the Claude resources catalog, representing 292 unique source URLs because one canonical article appears twice in the catalog. All 292 source pages were retrieved successfully. Summaries were produced from the full extracted article bodies—not landing-page excerpts—and preserve the original title, date, category, and source link.

The derived lessons contain 318,567 words in total, with a median depth of 1,192 words per article. They are summaries, not replacements for current product documentation: availability, pricing, model behavior, and recommended deployment practices can change after an article is published.
